title: Adana Kebap
description: A classic Turkish dish originating from Adana, this kebap is made with lamb and spices. Serve with rice, salad, or flatbread for a complete meal.
instructions: Combine lamb, Turkish Spice Mix, Spicy Red Pepper Paste, garlic, and onion in a bowl. Mix well and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat Aromatic Olive Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Transfer the lamb to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce the heat to medium and add a bit more oil to the skillet if needed. Add the bread and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until toasted.
Serve the lamb with the toasted bread, salad, or rice. Enjoy!
Optional: Grill the lamb for a smoky flavor or cook it in a grill pan for a crispy exterior.
Make sure to cook the lamb to an internal temperature of at least 63°C (145°F) for food safety.
Let the lamb rest for 5-7 minutes before slicing and serving.
